gates.name: Evidence signal
gates.condition: Evidence e(k,c) ranks hospitals' true per-class counts with Spearman >= 0.7 on S1
gates.ifFails: One retry (bias row, or evidence averaged over 3 rounds); if still below 0.7, Fallback F1
gates.note: Came in under the bar on its one allowed retry, so the project took Fallback F1 as planned. A sign-aware amendment (M1) scored 0.11, also under the bar.

gates.name: Baseline quality
gates.condition: Tier A FedAvg reaches balanced accuracy >= 0.45
gates.ifFails: Unfreeze the last dense block and re-extract features. One retry.
gates.note: Passed on the design doc's retry: the last dense block fine-tuned by FedAvg, features re-extracted.

gates.name: Problem is real
gates.condition: On S1 or S2, under Camp A, attack A1 gives the attacker >= 2x its FedAvg weight on a rare row AND drops that class's F1 by >= 0.15, with balanced accuracy falling < 0.03
gates.result: S1: F1 drop 0.09 (needs >= 0.15) · S2: F1 drop 0.24 but balanced accuracy fell 0.051 (must be < 0.03)
gates.note: The attack succeeds on neither split: Fallback F1 - an empirical study of how rare-class-aware aggregation behaves on a real hospital split.

gates.name: EARN works
gates.condition: Under A1 and A2, EARN's rare-class F1 stays within 0.05 of no-attack; with no attack within 0.02 of Camp A and above FedAvg; honest centre 2 reaches trust >= 0.8
gates.result: Not evaluable while the measured evidence signal sits under its bar
gates.note: Exploratory re-run on an oracle evidence signal: conditions not met on S1, not met on S2. Reported as exploratory, never as the gate.

gates.name: Indian baseline quality
gates.condition: FedAvg on the age-band split reaches balanced accuracy >= 0.40 over 7 classes
gates.ifFails: DermaCon-IN is used for external validation only, and the shortfall is reported
gates.note: Cleared by 0.008 - narrow enough to say so. 40 rounds, seed 42, on the constructed age-band split.

gates.name: Does EARN help on Indian data?
gates.condition: Rare-class F1 within 0.05 of FedAvg, the specialist weighted above its size share, and no effect on the near-IID control
gates.ifFails: Reported as measured; the cause is diagnosed rather than tuned away
gates.result: 2 of 3 conditions met; the specialist ended on 0.068 of the rare rows against a 0.079 size share
gates.note: EARN's holder threshold is an absolute count of 20 images, calibrated on Fed-ISIC2019; at this dataset's scale it admits almost nobody, so trust and evidence never engage. A scale-relative threshold was then pre-registered on Fed-ISIC2019 and rejected there: a bar set by the round's own evidence is one a claiming attacker clears by claiming.
